what: Canadian Etsy seller reports having to raise prices globally to cover US tariffs because Etsy does not allow US-specific pricing, inadvertently pricing themselves out of other international markets.
verbatim_snippet: "Etsy needs to add a separate area for US pricing without including it in global pricing. My global buyers are paying the same price as the US. I've priced myself out of other markets because I need to raise my prices for the US market to cover the tariffs. I'm based in Canada. Is anyone else having this issue?"
notes: community.etsy.com requires login. Content retrieved from Google search index. Canada-based seller. Platform limitation: Etsy only allows domestic and "everywhere else" pricing tiers, no US-specific pricing. Exact date not confirmed from index; thread context places it in mid-2025 tariff era.
